units.source_text: 两个客人都是学生模样。

en.t: The two guests both looked like students.

units.source_text: 阿泷大胆地站在他们两人面前。

en.t: Otaki boldly stood in front of the two of them.

units.source_text: 他们感到仿佛有一阵暖风吹拂过来，于是走出了澡塘，坐在边上，把头耷拉下来。

en.t: They felt as if a warm breeze had blown over them, so they got out of the bath, sat on the edge, and hung their heads.
